why: Drops the return-to-rest at the end of the recoil. This writes onto an object another system owns (entities.ts's barrel mesh), on an axis `sync` never reassigns, so the last frame's offset is PERMANENT: the tank fights on with its gun sitting short in its ring, a little further back after every shot. As a dev-flagged refusal arm this leaked only for whoever set the flag; since #526 it would reach every player on every shot, which is what moves it from a blemish to a defect.
killedBy: barrel recoil (issue #526, parent #356) puts the gun back at EXACTLY rest when the recoil ends
